statement: An explicit simple two-dimensional F2[Q] quotient of Nab/2 gives H=B/L of order2304, with L free of rank385. The mixed-prime quotient J=B/[L,L]L^3 admits a cusp-preserving automorphism with the extra CM pair A=I, beta=(9,8;4,9), multiplier1. Its conjugators and action match D.27 on the exact common quotient C=H times_Q G3, so one compatible action extends to J times_C (H2 times_Q P3). The N-kernel of J is a nontrivial semidirect product F3^385 by C2^2; its maximal nilpotent quotient is C2^2 times F3^97, proving that J is outside the preceding products of relative pro-prime completions.
depends_on: the exact graph cover, averaging, maximal common quotient, and subdirect-product arguments proved in D.28
notes: The compatible system has482 independent linear constraints in770 variables and affine dimension288. The22nd tested vector has rank385.
